1	/-
2	  TrafficSpec.Core.Language.RuleEval
3	  Evaluating a rule over a trace, and checking it before any trace.
4	
5	  `verdicts` combines the binder classes, the applicability and the obligation per instant
6	  (Kleene, `verdictAt`). `check` finds from the syntax every defect the evaluator would otherwise
7	  report as `malformed` or `unboundVariable`; its doc comment lists them. `checkReading`
8	  names the parameters and aggregates the reading lacks, over the rule and the rules it composes,
9	  with their concept calls expanded; `Concept.checkReading` the aggregates a concept's body names.
10	
11	  `Concept.check` holds a concept to the same standard on every admissible instantiation of
12	  its formals, with its calls expanded. `Concept.callDefects` holds every concept call to the
13	  callee's signature before expansion loses it.
14	
15	  Nothing under Rules/ or Concepts/ imports this file; Grounding, Manifest and Monitor do.
16	-/
17	import TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Rule
18	import TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Concept
19	import TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Semantics
20	import TrafficSpec.Core.Language.EvalFast
21	
22	namespace TrafficSpec
23	namespace Rule
24	open Semantics
25	
26	/-- A rule's formula as evaluated: every comparison over a `cond` decided by cases, through the
27	    sub-expression cache (`evalFastAll`, whose every stored value is the one `evalAll` gives). -/
28	def evalRuleFormula (c : SemCtx) (φ : Formula) : Array R := evalFastAll c (Formula.elimCond φ)
29	
30	/-- Every binder's class holds for its bound track and the applicability holds, per instant. -/
31	def engagedAll (r : Rule) (c : SemCtx) : Array R :=
32	  Temporal.allOf c.n (r.binders.map (fun b => evalRuleFormula c b.cls) ++ [evalRuleFormula c r.applicability])
33	
34	/-- The verdict at every instant. -/
35	def verdicts (r : Rule) (c : SemCtx) : Array Verdict :=
36	  Array.zipWith verdictAt (r.engagedAll c) (evalRuleFormula c r.obligation)
37	
38	/-- The rule as a three-valued statement per instant: complied with (true), violated (false), or
39	    unknown. Not engaged counts as complied with — a rule that does not apply is not broken. -/
40	def asRAll (r : Rule) (c : SemCtx) : Array R :=
41	  (r.verdicts c).map fun v => match v with
42	    | .compliant | .notApplicable => R.t
43	    | .violated => R.f
44	    | .unknown w => ⟨.u, w⟩
45	
46	/-- Structural well-formedness apart from having a binder: binders named and distinct, the id
47	    set, every assumption and intention used declared, every intention id well-formed, every
48	    operationalization bounding its standard by atoms, primitives or concepts. -/
49	def wellFormedBody (r : Rule) : Bool :=
50	  r.binderNames.eraseDups.length == r.binders.length &&
51	  r.binders.all (fun b => !b.name.isEmpty) &&
52	  !r.id.isEmpty &&
53	  r.usedAssumptions.all (r.assumptions.contains ·) &&
54	  r.usedIntentions.all (r.intentions.contains ·) &&
55	  r.intentions.all IntId.wellFormed &&
56	  r.operationalizations.all (fun o => !o.concepts.isEmpty && o.concepts.all fun c =>
57	    c.startsWith "drv." || Primitives.primitiveNames.contains (defName c) || knowsAtom (defName c))
58	
59	/-- Structural well-formedness: at least one binder, and `wellFormedBody`. -/
60	def wellFormed (r : Rule) : Bool := !r.binders.isEmpty && r.wellFormedBody
61	
62	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
63	-- Static check
64	-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
65	/-- Variables in scope with their sorts, the innermost first. -/
66	abbrev Scope := List (String × EntityKind)
67	
68	/-- Whether `v` is bound and its innermost binding has sort `k`, as evaluation's lookup reads it. -/
69	def Scope.binds (scope : Scope) (v : String) (k : EntityKind) : Bool :=
70	  (scope.find? (·.1 == v)).map (·.2) == some k
71	
72	/-- Resolve arguments against the scope with dummy ids, checking each variable's sort against the
73	    position's expected sort when the table knows it. An entity position takes a variable only:
74	    a literal or a number there would name a track, region or device the rule has no right to. -/
75	private def dummyArgs (scope : Scope) (sorts : Option (List (Option EntityKind))) (args : List Arg)
76	    : Except String (List Primitives.DArg) :=
77	  (args.zip (List.range args.length)).mapM fun (a, k) =>
78	    match a with
79	    | .var v =>
80	      match scope.find? (·.1 == v) with
81	      | none => .error s!"variable `{v}` is not bound"
82	      | some (_, vs) =>
83	        match sorts.bind (·[k]?) with
84	        | some (some want) => if want == vs then .ok (.v 0) else .error s!"variable `{v}` has sort {repr vs}, position {k} wants {repr want}"
85	        | some none => .error s!"variable `{v}` where position {k} takes a literal"
86	        | none => .ok (.v 0)
87	    | .lit l =>
88	      match sorts.bind (·[k]?) with
89	      | some (some want) => .error s!"literal `{l}` where position {k} wants a {repr want}"
90	      | _ => .ok (.s l)
91	    | .nat n =>
92	      match sorts.bind (·[k]?) with
93	      | some (some want) => .error s!"number `{n}` where position {k} wants a {repr want}"
94	      | _ => .ok (.n n)
95	
96	private def isMalformed : UnknownReason → Option String
97	  | .malformed w => some w
98	  | .parameterMissing w => some w
99	  | _ => none
100	
101	private def emptyScene : Scene := { t := 0 }
102	private def emptyCtx : Primitives.Ctx := { scenes := #[], times := #[], ρ := {} }
103	
104	/-- A quantifier's kind: a spelling the codec decodes. A variable is a concept's literal formal
105	    that reached the check unfilled. -/
106	private def kindErrors (where_ : String) (a : Arg) (what : String) (known : String → Bool) : List String :=
107	  match a with
108	  | .lit s => if known s then [] else [s!"{where_}: {what} kind `{s}` names no kind"]
109	  | .var v => [s!"{where_}: {what} kind `{v}` is a variable; spell the kind, or fill it from a literal formal"]
110	  | .nat _ => [s!"{where_}: {what} kind is a number"]
111	
112	private def constParamErrors (where_ name : String) (ps : List Term) : List String :=
113	  ps.filter (!Term.isConstant ·) |>.map fun _ => s!"{where_}: `{name}` parameter is not a constant term"
114	
115	/-- A heading change's step bound: a literal or a reading parameter, a literal strictly positive. -/
116	private def stepErrors (where_ : String) : Term → List String
117	  | .lit q _ => if Q.lt Q.zero q then [] else [s!"{where_}: heading_since step bound is not strictly positive"]
118	  | .param _ => []
119	  | _ => [s!"{where_}: heading_since step bound is not a literal or a reading parameter"]
120	
121	mutual
122	  partial def checkTerm (scope : Scope) (where_ : String) : Term → List String
123	    | .lit _ _ | .param _ => []
124	    | .measure a args =>
125	      match dummyArgs scope (atomArgSorts a) args with
126	      | .error e => [s!"{where_}: {e}"]
127	      | .ok ds => match evalMeasure emptyScene a ds with
128	        | .error w => match isMalformed w with | some m => [s!"{where_}: measure `{a}`: {m}"] | none => []
129	        | .ok _ => []
130	    | .quantity concept args ps =>
131	      let inner := ps.flatMap (checkTerm scope where_) ++ constParamErrors where_ concept ps
132	      match dummyArgs scope (Primitives.argSorts concept) args with
133	      | .error e => [s!"{where_}: {e}"] ++ inner
134	      | .ok ds => match Primitives.evalQ concept emptyCtx ds (ps.map fun _ => Q.zero) with
135	        | .error w => (match isMalformed w with | some m => [s!"{where_}: `{concept}`: {m}"] | none => []) ++ inner
136	        | .ok _ => inner
137	    | .distanceWhile subj φ =>
138	      (if scope.binds subj .track then [] else [s!"{where_}: subject `{subj}` is not a bound track"]) ++
139	      checkFormula scope where_ φ
140	    | .sinceRise φ => checkFormula scope where_ φ
141	    | .headingSince subj g ψ =>
142	      (if scope.binds subj .track then [] else [s!"{where_}: subject `{subj}` is not a bound track"]) ++
143	      stepErrors where_ g ++ checkTerm scope where_ g ++ checkFormula scope where_ ψ
144	    | .aggregate _ v φ t => checkFormula ((v, .track) :: scope) where_ φ ++ checkTerm ((v, .track) :: scope) where_ t
145	    | .add a b | .sub a b | .mul a b | .div a b => checkTerm scope where_ a ++ checkTerm scope where_ b
146	    | .neg a | .abs a => checkTerm scope where_ a
147	    | .cond φ a b => checkFormula scope where_ φ ++ checkTerm scope where_ a ++ checkTerm scope where_ b
148	
149	  partial def checkFormula (scope : Scope) (where_ : String) : Formula → List String
150	    | .tt | .ff | .asm _ => []
151	    | .intent _ who target =>
152	      [(who, EntityKind.track, "road user"), (target, EntityKind.region, "region")].flatMap fun (a, want, what) =>
153	        match a with
154	        | .var v => if scope.binds v want then [] else [s!"{where_}: intent's {what} `{v}` is not a bound {repr want}"]
155	        | _ => [s!"{where_}: intent's {what} is a variable"]
156	    | .same a b => [a, b].flatMap fun arg => match arg with
157	      | .var v => if scope.any (·.1 == v) then [] else [s!"{where_}: variable `{v}` is not bound"]
158	      | _ => [s!"{where_}: `same` compares two bound variables"]
159	    | .atom name args ps =>
160	      let inner := ps.flatMap (checkTerm scope where_) ++ constParamErrors where_ name ps
161	      match dummyArgs scope (atomArgSorts name) args with
162	      | .error e => [s!"{where_}: {e}"] ++ inner
163	      | .ok ds =>
164	        if name == "ru_aggregate" then inner     -- membership is the reading's; `checkReading` holds the word
165	        else match evalAtomE emptyScene name ds (ps.map fun _ => Q.zero) with
166	        | .error w => (match isMalformed w with | some m => [s!"{where_}: atom `{name}`: {m}"] | none => []) ++ inner
167	        | .ok _ => inner
168	    | .cmp l _ r => checkTerm scope where_ l ++ checkTerm scope where_ r
169	    | .not φ | .always φ | .eventually φ => checkFormula scope where_ φ
170	    | .and φ ψ | .or φ ψ | .implies φ ψ | .until φ ψ | .since φ ψ => checkFormula scope where_ φ ++ checkFormula scope where_ ψ
171	    | .holdsFor m d subj φ | .within m d subj φ =>
172	      windowErrors scope where_ m d subj ++ checkTerm scope where_ d ++ checkFormula scope where_ φ
173	    | .untilWithin m d subj φ ψ =>
174	      windowErrors scope where_ m d subj ++ checkTerm scope where_ d ++ checkFormula scope where_ φ ++ checkFormula scope where_ ψ
175	    | .atLast m d subj ψ φ =>
176	      windowErrors scope where_ m d subj ++ checkTerm scope where_ d ++ checkFormula scope where_ ψ ++ checkFormula scope where_ φ
177	    | .count e sφ _ _ => checkFormula scope where_ e ++ checkFormula scope where_ sφ
178	    | .rises φ => checkFormula scope where_ φ
179	    | .definedWhen p φ => checkFormula scope where_ p ++ checkFormula scope where_ φ
180	    | .derived concept args ps =>
181	      let inner := ps.flatMap (checkTerm scope where_) ++ constParamErrors where_ concept ps
182	      match dummyArgs scope (Primitives.argSorts concept) args with
183	      | .error e => [s!"{where_}: {e}"] ++ inner
184	      | .ok ds => match Primitives.evalB concept emptyCtx ds (ps.map fun _ => Q.zero) with
185	        | .error w => (match isMalformed w with | some m => [s!"{where_}: `{concept}`: {m}"] | none => []) ++ inner
186	        | .ok _ => inner
187	    | .rule _ map | .ruleApplies _ map => map.flatMap fun (_, outer) =>
188	        if scope.binds outer .track then [] else [s!"{where_}: composition maps to `{outer}`, not a bound track"]
189	    | .existsRegion k v φ | .forallRegion k v φ =>
190	      kindErrors where_ k "region" (fun s => (StructureKind.ofString s).isSome) ++ checkFormula ((v, .region) :: scope) where_ φ
191	    | .existsDevice k v φ | .forallDevice k v φ =>
192	      kindErrors where_ k "device" (fun s => (DeviceKind.ofString s).isSome) ++ checkFormula ((v, .device) :: scope) where_ φ
193	    | .existsUser v φ | .forallUser v φ => checkFormula ((v, .track) :: scope) where_ φ
194	
195	  partial def windowErrors (scope : Scope) (where_ : String) (m : Measure) (d : Term) (subj : String) : List String :=
196	    (if m = .path && !scope.binds subj .track then [s!"{where_}: window subject `{subj}` is not a bound track"] else []) ++
197	    (if Term.isConstant d then [] else [s!"{where_}: window length is not a constant term"])
198	end
199	
200	-- A declared intention read ahead of the judged observation: an `intent` leaf, or a composed
201	-- rule that reads one, within the scope of a future operator, in a formula or a term.
202	mutual
203	  partial def futureTerm (reads : String → Bool) (fut : Bool) : Term → List String
204	    | .quantity _ _ ps => ps.flatMap (futureTerm reads fut)
205	    | .distanceWhile _ φ | .sinceRise φ => futureReads reads fut φ
206	    | .headingSince _ g ψ => futureTerm reads fut g ++ futureReads reads fut ψ
207	    | .aggregate _ _ φ t => futureReads reads fut φ ++ futureTerm reads fut t
208	    | .add a b | .sub a b | .mul a b | .div a b => futureTerm reads fut a ++ futureTerm reads fut b
209	    | .neg a | .abs a => futureTerm reads fut a
210	    | .cond φ a b => futureReads reads fut φ ++ futureTerm reads fut a ++ futureTerm reads fut b
211	    | _ => []
212	  partial def futureReads (reads : String → Bool) (fut : Bool) : Formula → List String
213	    | .intent id _ _ => if fut then [s!"declared intention `{id}` is read ahead of the judged observation"] else []
214	    | .rule id _ | .ruleApplies id _ =>
215	      if fut && reads id then [s!"`{id}` reads a declared intention and is read ahead of the judged observation"] else []
216	    | .atom _ _ ps | .derived _ _ ps => ps.flatMap (futureTerm reads fut)
217	    | .cmp l _ r => futureTerm reads fut l ++ futureTerm reads fut r
218	    | .always φ | .eventually φ => futureReads reads true φ
219	    | .until φ ψ => futureReads reads true φ ++ futureReads reads true ψ
220	    | .within _ d _ φ => futureTerm reads fut d ++ futureReads reads true φ
221	    | .untilWithin _ d _ φ ψ => futureTerm reads fut d ++ futureReads reads true φ ++ futureReads reads true ψ
222	    | .not φ | .rises φ => futureReads reads fut φ
223	    | .and φ ψ | .or φ ψ | .implies φ ψ | .since φ ψ | .definedWhen φ ψ => futureReads reads fut φ ++ futureReads reads fut ψ
224	    | .holdsFor _ d _ φ => futureTerm reads fut d ++ futureReads reads fut φ
225	    | .atLast _ d _ ψ φ => futureTerm reads fut d ++ futureReads reads fut ψ ++ futureReads reads fut φ
226	    | .count e sφ _ _ => futureReads reads fut e ++ futureReads reads fut sφ
227	    | .existsRegion _ _ φ | .forallRegion _ _ φ | .existsDevice _ _ φ | .forallDevice _ _ φ
228	    | .existsUser _ φ | .forallUser _ φ => futureReads reads fut φ
229	    | _ => []
230	end
231	
232	-- The distance travelled since the trace began (`kin_path_length`), whose zero is the start of the
233	-- recording, read where it can decide a search into the past: inside an operand of `since`, of
234	-- `atLast` or of `count`, inside the formula of `sinceRise`, the onset of `headingSince` or the
235	-- formula of `rises`, directly or through a composed rule that reads it. Everywhere else it is
236	-- ordinary arithmetic; path windows and `distanceWhile` measure differences and are never this.
237	mutual
238	  partial def pathTerm (reads : String → Bool) (back : Bool) : Term → List String
239	    | .measure "kin_path_length" _ =>
240	      if back then ["the distance travelled since the trace began (`kin_path_length`) is read inside a search into the past (`since`, `sinceRise`, `atLast`, `count` or `rises`); the start of a recording is no event of a road user's history"] else []
241	    | .quantity _ _ ps => ps.flatMap (pathTerm reads back)
242	    | .distanceWhile _ φ => pathReads reads back φ
243	    | .sinceRise φ => pathReads reads true φ
244	    | .headingSince _ g ψ => pathTerm reads back g ++ pathReads reads true ψ
245	    | .aggregate _ _ φ t => pathReads reads back φ ++ pathTerm reads back t
246	    | .add a b | .sub a b | .mul a b | .div a b => pathTerm reads back a ++ pathTerm reads back b
247	    | .neg a | .abs a => pathTerm reads back a
248	    | .cond φ a b => pathReads reads back φ ++ pathTerm reads back a ++ pathTerm reads back b
249	    | _ => []
250	  partial def pathReads (reads : String → Bool) (back : Bool) : Formula → List String
251	    | .rule id _ | .ruleApplies id _ =>
252	      if back && reads id then [s!"`{id}` reads the distance travelled since the trace began and is composed inside a search into the past"] else []
253	    | .atom _ _ ps | .derived _ _ ps => ps.flatMap (pathTerm reads back)
254	    | .cmp l _ r => pathTerm reads back l ++ pathTerm reads back r
255	    | .since φ ψ => pathReads reads true φ ++ pathReads reads true ψ
256	    | .atLast _ d _ ψ φ => pathTerm reads back d ++ pathReads reads true ψ ++ pathReads reads true φ
257	    | .count e sφ _ _ => pathReads reads true e ++ pathReads reads true sφ
258	    | .rises φ => pathReads reads true φ
259	    | .not φ | .always φ | .eventually φ => pathReads reads back φ
260	    | .and φ ψ | .or φ ψ | .implies φ ψ | .until φ ψ | .definedWhen φ ψ => pathReads reads back φ ++ pathReads reads back ψ
261	    | .holdsFor _ d _ φ | .within _ d _ φ => pathTerm reads back d ++ pathReads reads back φ
262	    | .untilWithin _ d _ φ ψ => pathTerm reads back d ++ pathReads reads back φ ++ pathReads reads back ψ
263	    | .existsRegion _ _ φ | .forallRegion _ _ φ | .existsDevice _ _ φ | .forallDevice _ _ φ
264	    | .existsUser _ φ | .forallUser _ φ => pathReads reads back φ
265	    | _ => []
266	end
267	
268	/-- Whether a rule, or a rule it composes, reads `kin_path_length` anywhere. -/
269	def readsPath (rules : List Rule) (r : Rule) : Bool :=
270	  (closure rules r).any fun x => x.formulas.any fun φ => !(pathReads (fun _ => false) true φ).isEmpty
271	
272	/-- Every defect a rule has before any trace; empty for a rule the evaluator will never report
273	    `malformed` or `unboundVariable` on: an empty id; no binder, or one unnamed or named twice;
274	    an assumption or intention read but not declared, or an intention id ill-formed; an
275	    operationalization bounded by nothing, or by a name that is no atom, primitive or concept; a
276	    name no table knows; an atom, measure, primitive or concept given the wrong number of
277	    arguments; an unbound variable, or one of the wrong sort where a track, region or device is
278	    read (such a position takes a variable, never a spelling or a number; a literal position
279	    takes no variable); a spelling no enumeration decodes; a quantifier kind that is not a
280	    spelling; a parameter of an atom or a call, or a window's length, that is not a constant
281	    term (a literal, a reading parameter, or arithmetic over them); a heading change's step bound
282	    that is not a literal or a reading parameter, or a literal one not strictly positive; a
283	    declared intention read ahead of the judged observation; the distance travelled since the trace began read inside a
284	    search into the past; a composed rule not in the set, or a map that names a variable not
285	    bound to a track, misses one of its binders or names one it does not have. `regions` names
286	    variables the caller binds to regions: the region formals of a concept's instance, which
287	    alone may then have no binder. -/
288	def check (rules : List Rule) (r : Rule) (regions : List String := []) : List String :=
289	  let scope : Scope := r.binderNames.map (fun n => (n, EntityKind.track)) ++ regions.map fun n => (n, EntityKind.region)
290	  let formed := if regions.isEmpty then r.wellFormed else r.wellFormedBody
291	  let reads (id : String) : Bool := match rules.find? (·.id == id) with
292	    | some r' => r'.readsIntention rules
293	    | none => false
294	  (if formed then [] else [s!"{r.id}: binders empty, duplicated or unnamed, an assumption, intention or concept undeclared, or an intention id ill-formed"]) ++
295	  (r.binders.flatMap fun b => checkFormula [(b.name, .track)] s!"{r.id} binder `{b.name}`" b.cls) ++
296	  checkFormula scope s!"{r.id} applicability" r.applicability ++
297	  checkFormula scope s!"{r.id} obligation" r.obligation ++
298	  (r.formulas.flatMap (futureReads reads false) |>.eraseDups.map fun e => s!"{r.id}: {e}") ++
299	  (r.formulas.flatMap (pathReads (fun id => (rules.find? (·.id == id)).any (readsPath rules)) false)
300	    |>.eraseDups.map fun e => s!"{r.id}: {e}") ++
301	  (r.formulas.flatMap Formula.compositions).flatMap (fun (id, map) =>
302	    match rules.find? (·.id == id) with
303	    | none => [s!"{r.id}: composes unknown rule `{id}`"]
304	    | some r' =>
305	      (map.filter (fun (inner, _) => !r'.binderNames.contains inner) |>.map fun (inner, _) => s!"{r.id}: composition of `{id}` maps `{inner}`, not one of its binders") ++
306	      (r'.binderNames.filter (fun b => !map.any (·.1 == b)) |>.map fun b => s!"{r.id}: composition of `{id}` leaves its binder `{b}` unmapped"))
307	
308	/-- The aggregate ids `who` names that the reading does not declare, or whose declaration lists
309	    an id that is no road-user class. -/
310	def aggregateDefects (who : String) (ids : List String) (ρ : Reading) : List String :=
311	  ids.eraseDups.flatMap fun w =>
312	    match ρ.aggregate w with
313	    | none => [s!"{who}: aggregate `{w}` is not declared by the reading"]
314	    | some a => (a.included ++ a.unresolved).filter (fun id => !id.startsWith "ru." || (RoadUserClass.ofString (id.drop 3).toString).isNone)
315	        |>.map fun id => s!"{who}: aggregate `{w}` lists `{id}`, which is not a road-user class"
316	
317	/-- Parameters and aggregates that the rule, or a rule it composes, names and the reading lacks,
318	    each rule read with its calls of the concepts `cs` expanded. -/
319	def checkReading (rules : List Rule) (r : Rule) (ρ : Reading) (cs : List Concept := []) : List String :=
320	  (Rule.closure rules r).flatMap fun x =>
321	    let xx := Concept.expandRule cs x
322	    (xx.params.filter (!ρ.has ·) |>.map fun p => s!"{x.id}: parameter `{p}` is not in the reading")
323	    ++ aggregateDefects x.id (xx.formulas.flatMap Formula.aggregateIds) ρ
324	
325	end Rule
326	
327	/-- Rule composition over a library, with fuel bounding the nesting depth. The composed rule's
328	    binders are bound through `map` (inner binder ↦ caller variable); an unmapped binder is an
329	    unbound variable, an unknown id is `compositionUnknown`. `engaged` selects the composed
330	    rule's applicability (for an exception or a condition) over its compliance. -/
331	def composeWith (rules : List Rule) (d : Primitives.Ctx) :
332	    Nat → String → List (String × String) → Binding → Bool → Array R
333	  | 0, id, _, _, _ => Array.replicate d.n (R.u (.compositionUnknown id))
334	  | fuel + 1, id, map, β, engaged =>
335	    match rules.find? (·.id == id) with
336	    | none => Array.replicate d.n (R.u (.compositionUnknown id))
337	    | some r =>
338	      let β' : Binding := ⟨map.filterMap fun (inner, outer) => (β.lookup outer).map fun v => (inner, v)⟩
339	      let c : Semantics.SemCtx := { d := d, β := β', compose := composeWith rules d fuel }
340	      if engaged then r.engagedAll c else r.asRAll c
341	
342	/-- The evaluation context for a rule set over an indexed trace: composition resolves against
343	    `rules`, nested at most `rules.length` deep. -/
344	def Rule.context (rules : List Rule) (d : Primitives.Ctx) (β : Binding) : Semantics.SemCtx :=
345	  { d := d, β := β, compose := composeWith rules d rules.length }
346	
347	namespace Concept
348	open Semantics
349	
350	-- Every concept call against the callee's signature: a track formal takes a variable bound to a
351	-- track, a region formal one bound to a region, a literal formal one of its admissible values, a
352	-- nat formal a number. Run on formulas whose own literal and nat formals already hold values.
353	mutual
354	  partial def termCallDefects (cs : List Concept) (scope : Rule.Scope) (where_ : String) : Term → List String
355	    | .quantity n args ps => callArgs cs scope where_ n args ++ ps.flatMap (termCallDefects cs scope where_)
356	    | .measure _ _ | .lit _ _ | .param _ => []
357	    | .distanceWhile _ φ | .sinceRise φ => callDefects cs scope where_ φ
358	    | .headingSince _ g ψ => termCallDefects cs scope where_ g ++ callDefects cs scope where_ ψ
359	    | .aggregate _ v φ t => callDefects cs ((v, .track) :: scope) where_ φ ++ termCallDefects cs ((v, .track) :: scope) where_ t
360	    | .add a b | .sub a b | .mul a b | .div a b => termCallDefects cs scope where_ a ++ termCallDefects cs scope where_ b
361	    | .neg a | .abs a => termCallDefects cs scope where_ a
362	    | .cond φ a b => callDefects cs scope where_ φ ++ termCallDefects cs scope where_ a ++ termCallDefects cs scope where_ b
363	  partial def callDefects (cs : List Concept) (scope : Rule.Scope) (where_ : String) : Formula → List String
364	    | .derived n args ps => callArgs cs scope where_ n args ++ ps.flatMap (termCallDefects cs scope where_)
365	    | .atom _ _ ps => ps.flatMap (termCallDefects cs scope where_)
366	    | .cmp l _ r => termCallDefects cs scope where_ l ++ termCallDefects cs scope where_ r
367	    | .not φ | .always φ | .eventually φ | .rises φ => callDefects cs scope where_ φ
368	    | .and φ ψ | .or φ ψ | .implies φ ψ | .until φ ψ | .since φ ψ | .definedWhen φ ψ | .count φ ψ _ _ =>
369	      callDefects cs scope where_ φ ++ callDefects cs scope where_ ψ
370	    | .holdsFor _ d _ φ | .within _ d _ φ => termCallDefects cs scope where_ d ++ callDefects cs scope where_ φ
371	    | .untilWithin _ d _ φ ψ | .atLast _ d _ φ ψ =>
372	      termCallDefects cs scope where_ d ++ callDefects cs scope where_ φ ++ callDefects cs scope where_ ψ
373	    | .existsUser v φ | .forallUser v φ => callDefects cs ((v, .track) :: scope) where_ φ
374	    | .existsRegion _ v φ | .forallRegion _ v φ => callDefects cs ((v, .region) :: scope) where_ φ
375	    | .existsDevice _ v φ | .forallDevice _ v φ => callDefects cs ((v, .device) :: scope) where_ φ
376	    | _ => []
377	  partial def callArgs (cs : List Concept) (scope : Rule.Scope) (where_ name : String) (args : List Arg) : List String :=
378	    match cs.find? (·.leanName == name) with
379	    | none => []
380	    | some c =>
381	      if args.length != c.args.length then []        -- an arity the expansion leaves for `Rule.check` to report
382	      else (c.args.zip args).filterMap fun ((n, so), a) =>
383	        let bad := some s!"{where_}: `{c.id}` formal `{n}` ({repr so}) is given {repr a}"
384	        match so, a with
385	        | .track, .var v => if scope.binds v .track then none else bad
386	        | .region, .var v => if scope.binds v .region then none else bad
387	        | .literal vs, .lit l => if vs.contains l then none else bad
388	        | .nat, .nat _ => none
389	        | _, _ => bad
390	end
391	
392	/-- `callDefects` on a rule before expansion: each binder's class with that binder, the
393	    applicability and the obligation with every binder, all as tracks. -/
394	def ruleCallDefects (cs : List Concept) (r : Rule) : List String :=
395	  let scope : Rule.Scope := r.binderNames.map fun n => (n, EntityKind.track)
396	  (r.binders.flatMap fun b => callDefects cs [(b.name, .track)] s!"{r.id} binder `{b.name}`" b.cls) ++
397	  callDefects cs scope s!"{r.id} applicability" r.applicability ++
398	  callDefects cs scope s!"{r.id} obligation" r.obligation
399	
400	
401	/-- Every defect a concept has before any trace: an empty id; a formal or a parameter named
402	    twice; a parameter named as a reading's, or a body parameter that is no formal parameter; a
403	    literal formal that admits no value; a composed rule or a declared intention in the body (a
404	    concept reads neither); a referenced concept unknown, or a reference cycle; and, on every
405	    admissible instantiation of its literal formals with its calls expanded, every defect
406	    `Rule.check` finds in a formula and a call whose arguments do not fit the callee's formals. -/
407	def check (cs : List Concept) (c : Concept) : List String :=
408	  let names := c.args.map (·.1)
409	  let pnames := c.paramNames
410	  let body := c.bodyFormula
411	  let structural :=
412	    (if c.id.isEmpty then ["concept: empty id"] else []) ++
413	    (if names.eraseDups.length != names.length then [s!"{c.id}: duplicate formal argument"] else []) ++
414	    (if pnames.eraseDups.length != pnames.length then [s!"{c.id}: duplicate formal parameter"] else []) ++
415	    (pnames.filter (·.contains '.') |>.map fun p => s!"{c.id}: parameter `{p}` names a reading parameter; a body references its formals only") ++
416	    (c.args.filterMap fun (n, s) => match s with
417	      | .literal [] => some s!"{c.id}: literal formal `{n}` admits no value"
418	      | _ => none) ++
419	    ((Formula.params body).eraseDups.filter (!pnames.contains ·) |>.map fun p => s!"{c.id}: `{p}` is not a formal parameter") ++
420	    ((Formula.composed body).map fun id => s!"{c.id}: a concept composes no rule (`{id}`)") ++
421	    ((Formula.intentions body).eraseDups.map fun id => s!"{c.id}: a concept reads no declared intention (`{id}`)") ++
422	    (c.refs.filter (fun n => !cs.any (·.leanName == n))
423	      |>.map fun n => s!"{c.id}: references unknown concept `{n}`") ++
424	    (if (onCycle cs).contains c.id then [s!"{c.id}: on a reference cycle"] else [])
425	  let scope : Rule.Scope := c.args.filterMap fun (n, s) => match s with
426	    | .track => some (n, EntityKind.track)
427	    | .region => some (n, EntityKind.region)
428	    | _ => none
429	  let ps : List Term := c.params.map fun p => Term.param p.name
430	  let byInstance := (samples c).flatMap fun args =>
431	    match instantiate c args ps "check" with
432	    | none => [s!"{c.id}: arity"]
433	    | some b =>
434	      let φ := match b with | .formula φ => φ | .quantity t => Formula.cmp t .eq t
435	      let φx := expand cs φ
436	      callDefects cs scope c.id φ ++ Rule.checkFormula scope c.id φx ++
437	        (Rule.pathReads (fun _ => false) false φx).map fun e => s!"{c.id}: {e}"
438	  structural ++ byInstance.eraseDups
439	
440	/-- The aggregates a concept's body names, its calls expanded, that the reading does not declare
441	    or declares with an id that is no road-user class. -/
442	def checkReading (cs : List Concept) (c : Concept) (ρ : Reading) : List String :=
443	  Rule.aggregateDefects c.id (aggregateIds cs c) ρ
444	
445	end Concept
446	
447	end TrafficSpec

/-
  TrafficSpec.Core.Language.RuleEval
  Evaluating a rule over a trace, and checking it before any trace.

  `verdicts` combines the binder classes, the applicability and the obligation per instant
  (Kleene, `verdictAt`). `check` finds from the syntax every defect the evaluator would otherwise
  report as `malformed` or `unboundVariable`; its doc comment lists them. `checkReading`
  names the parameters and aggregates the reading lacks, over the rule and the rules it composes,
  with their concept calls expanded; `Concept.checkReading` the aggregates a concept's body names.

  `Concept.check` holds a concept to the same standard on every admissible instantiation of
  its formals, with its calls expanded. `Concept.callDefects` holds every concept call to the
  callee's signature before expansion loses it.

  Nothing under Rules/ or Concepts/ imports this file; Grounding, Manifest and Monitor do.
-/
import TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Rule
import TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Concept
import TrafficSpec.Core.Language.Semantics
import TrafficSpec.Core.Language.EvalFast

namespace TrafficSpec
namespace Rule
open Semantics

/-- A rule's formula as evaluated: every comparison over a `cond` decided by cases, through the
    sub-expression cache (`evalFastAll`, whose every stored value is the one `evalAll` gives). -/
def evalRuleFormula (c : SemCtx) (φ : Formula) : Array R := evalFastAll c (Formula.elimCond φ)

/-- Every binder's class holds for its bound track and the applicability holds, per instant. -/
def engagedAll (r : Rule) (c : SemCtx) : Array R :=
  Temporal.allOf c.n (r.binders.map (fun b => evalRuleFormula c b.cls) ++ [evalRuleFormula c r.applicability])

/-- The verdict at every instant. -/
def verdicts (r : Rule) (c : SemCtx) : Array Verdict :=
  Array.zipWith verdictAt (r.engagedAll c) (evalRuleFormula c r.obligation)

/-- The rule as a three-valued statement per instant: complied with (true), violated (false), or
    unknown. Not engaged counts as complied with — a rule that does not apply is not broken. -/
def asRAll (r : Rule) (c : SemCtx) : Array R :=
  (r.verdicts c).map fun v => match v with
    | .compliant | .notApplicable => R.t
    | .violated => R.f
    | .unknown w => ⟨.u, w⟩

/-- Structural well-formedness apart from having a binder: binders named and distinct, the id
    set, every assumption and intention used declared, every intention id well-formed, every
    operationalization bounding its standard by atoms, primitives or concepts. -/
def wellFormedBody (r : Rule) : Bool :=
  r.binderNames.eraseDups.length == r.binders.length &&
  r.binders.all (fun b => !b.name.isEmpty) &&
  !r.id.isEmpty &&
  r.usedAssumptions.all (r.assumptions.contains ·) &&
  r.usedIntentions.all (r.intentions.contains ·) &&
  r.intentions.all IntId.wellFormed &&
  r.operationalizations.all (fun o => !o.concepts.isEmpty && o.concepts.all fun c =>
    c.startsWith "drv." || Primitives.primitiveNames.contains (defName c) || knowsAtom (defName c))

/-- Structural well-formedness: at least one binder, and `wellFormedBody`. -/
def wellFormed (r : Rule) : Bool := !r.binders.isEmpty && r.wellFormedBody

-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Static check
-- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
/-- Variables in scope with their sorts, the innermost first. -/
abbrev Scope := List (String × EntityKind)

/-- Whether `v` is bound and its innermost binding has sort `k`, as evaluation's lookup reads it. -/
def Scope.binds (scope : Scope) (v : String) (k : EntityKind) : Bool :=
  (scope.find? (·.1 == v)).map (·.2) == some k

/-- Resolve arguments against the scope with dummy ids, checking each variable's sort against the
    position's expected sort when the table knows it. An entity position takes a variable only:
    a literal or a number there would name a track, region or device the rule has no right to. -/
private def dummyArgs (scope : Scope) (sorts : Option (List (Option EntityKind))) (args : List Arg)
    : Except String (List Primitives.DArg) :=
  (args.zip (List.range args.length)).mapM fun (a, k) =>
    match a with
    | .var v =>
      match scope.find? (·.1 == v) with
      | none => .error s!"variable `{v}` is not bound"
      | some (_, vs) =>
        match sorts.bind (·[k]?) with
        | some (some want) => if want == vs then .ok (.v 0) else .error s!"variable `{v}` has sort {repr vs}, position {k} wants {repr want}"
        | some none => .error s!"variable `{v}` where position {k} takes a literal"
        | none => .ok (.v 0)
    | .lit l =>
      match sorts.bind (·[k]?) with
      | some (some want) => .error s!"literal `{l}` where position {k} wants a {repr want}"
      | _ => .ok (.s l)
    | .nat n =>
      match sorts.bind (·[k]?) with
      | some (some want) => .error s!"number `{n}` where position {k} wants a {repr want}"
      | _ => .ok (.n n)

private def isMalformed : UnknownReason → Option String
  | .malformed w => some w
  | .parameterMissing w => some w
  | _ => none

private def emptyScene : Scene := { t := 0 }
private def emptyCtx : Primitives.Ctx := { scenes := #[], times := #[], ρ := {} }

/-- A quantifier's kind: a spelling the codec decodes. A variable is a concept's literal formal
    that reached the check unfilled. -/
private def kindErrors (where_ : String) (a : Arg) (what : String) (known : String → Bool) : List String :=
  match a with
  | .lit s => if known s then [] else [s!"{where_}: {what} kind `{s}` names no kind"]
  | .var v => [s!"{where_}: {what} kind `{v}` is a variable; spell the kind, or fill it from a literal formal"]
  | .nat _ => [s!"{where_}: {what} kind is a number"]

private def constParamErrors (where_ name : String) (ps : List Term) : List String :=
  ps.filter (!Term.isConstant ·) |>.map fun _ => s!"{where_}: `{name}` parameter is not a constant term"

/-- A heading change's step bound: a literal or a reading parameter, a literal strictly positive. -/
private def stepErrors (where_ : String) : Term → List String
  | .lit q _ => if Q.lt Q.zero q then [] else [s!"{where_}: heading_since step bound is not strictly positive"]
  | .param _ => []
  | _ => [s!"{where_}: heading_since step bound is not a literal or a reading parameter"]

mutual
  partial def checkTerm (scope : Scope) (where_ : String) : Term → List String
    | .lit _ _ | .param _ => []
    | .measure a args =>
      match dummyArgs scope (atomArgSorts a) args with
      | .error e => [s!"{where_}: {e}"]
      | .ok ds => match evalMeasure emptyScene a ds with
        | .error w => match isMalformed w with | some m => [s!"{where_}: measure `{a}`: {m}"] | none => []
        | .ok _ => []
    | .quantity concept args ps =>
      let inner := ps.flatMap (checkTerm scope where_) ++ constParamErrors where_ concept ps
      match dummyArgs scope (Primitives.argSorts concept) args with
      | .error e => [s!"{where_}: {e}"] ++ inner
      | .ok ds => match Primitives.evalQ concept emptyCtx ds (ps.map fun _ => Q.zero) with
        | .error w => (match isMalformed w with | some m => [s!"{where_}: `{concept}`: {m}"] | none => []) ++ inner
        | .ok _ => inner
    | .distanceWhile subj φ =>
      (if scope.binds subj .track then [] else [s!"{where_}: subject `{subj}` is not a bound track"]) ++
      checkFormula scope where_ φ
    | .sinceRise φ => checkFormula scope where_ φ
    | .headingSince subj g ψ =>
      (if scope.binds subj .track then [] else [s!"{where_}: subject `{subj}` is not a bound track"]) ++
      stepErrors where_ g ++ checkTerm scope where_ g ++ checkFormula scope where_ ψ
    | .aggregate _ v φ t => checkFormula ((v, .track) :: scope) where_ φ ++ checkTerm ((v, .track) :: scope) where_ t
    | .add a b | .sub a b | .mul a b | .div a b => checkTerm scope where_ a ++ checkTerm scope where_ b
    | .neg a | .abs a => checkTerm scope where_ a
    | .cond φ a b => checkFormula scope where_ φ ++ checkTerm scope where_ a ++ checkTerm scope where_ b

  partial def checkFormula (scope : Scope) (where_ : String) : Formula → List String
    | .tt | .ff | .asm _ => []
    | .intent _ who target =>
      [(who, EntityKind.track, "road user"), (target, EntityKind.region, "region")].flatMap fun (a, want, what) =>
        match a with
        | .var v => if scope.binds v want then [] else [s!"{where_}: intent's {what} `{v}` is not a bound {repr want}"]
        | _ => [s!"{where_}: intent's {what} is a variable"]
    | .same a b => [a, b].flatMap fun arg => match arg with
      | .var v => if scope.any (·.1 == v) then [] else [s!"{where_}: variable `{v}` is not bound"]
      | _ => [s!"{where_}: `same` compares two bound variables"]
    | .atom name args ps =>
      let inner := ps.flatMap (checkTerm scope where_) ++ constParamErrors where_ name ps
      match dummyArgs scope (atomArgSorts name) args with
      | .error e => [s!"{where_}: {e}"] ++ inner
      | .ok ds =>
        if name == "ru_aggregate" then inner     -- membership is the reading's; `checkReading` holds the word
        else match evalAtomE emptyScene name ds (ps.map fun _ => Q.zero) with
        | .error w => (match isMalformed w with | some m => [s!"{where_}: atom `{name}`: {m}"] | none => []) ++ inner
        | .ok _ => inner
    | .cmp l _ r => checkTerm scope where_ l ++ checkTerm scope where_ r
    | .not φ | .always φ | .eventually φ => checkFormula scope where_ φ
    | .and φ ψ | .or φ ψ | .implies φ ψ | .until φ ψ | .since φ ψ => checkFormula scope where_ φ ++ checkFormula scope where_ ψ
    | .holdsFor m d subj φ | .within m d subj φ =>
      windowErrors scope where_ m d subj ++ checkTerm scope where_ d ++ checkFormula scope where_ φ
    | .untilWithin m d subj φ ψ =>
      windowErrors scope where_ m d subj ++ checkTerm scope where_ d ++ checkFormula scope where_ φ ++ checkFormula scope where_ ψ
    | .atLast m d subj ψ φ =>
      windowErrors scope where_ m d subj ++ checkTerm scope where_ d ++ checkFormula scope where_ ψ ++ checkFormula scope where_ φ
    | .count e sφ _ _ => checkFormula scope where_ e ++ checkFormula scope where_ sφ
    | .rises φ => checkFormula scope where_ φ
    | .definedWhen p φ => checkFormula scope where_ p ++ checkFormula scope where_ φ
    | .derived concept args ps =>
      let inner := ps.flatMap (checkTerm scope where_) ++ constParamErrors where_ concept ps
      match dummyArgs scope (Primitives.argSorts concept) args with
      | .error e => [s!"{where_}: {e}"] ++ inner
      | .ok ds => match Primitives.evalB concept emptyCtx ds (ps.map fun _ => Q.zero) with
        | .error w => (match isMalformed w with | some m => [s!"{where_}: `{concept}`: {m}"] | none => []) ++ inner
        | .ok _ => inner
    | .rule _ map | .ruleApplies _ map => map.flatMap fun (_, outer) =>
        if scope.binds outer .track then [] else [s!"{where_}: composition maps to `{outer}`, not a bound track"]
    | .existsRegion k v φ | .forallRegion k v φ =>
      kindErrors where_ k "region" (fun s => (StructureKind.ofString s).isSome) ++ checkFormula ((v, .region) :: scope) where_ φ
    | .existsDevice k v φ | .forallDevice k v φ =>
      kindErrors where_ k "device" (fun s => (DeviceKind.ofString s).isSome) ++ checkFormula ((v, .device) :: scope) where_ φ
    | .existsUser v φ | .forallUser v φ => checkFormula ((v, .track) :: scope) where_ φ

  partial def windowErrors (scope : Scope) (where_ : String) (m : Measure) (d : Term) (subj : String) : List String :=
    (if m = .path && !scope.binds subj .track then [s!"{where_}: window subject `{subj}` is not a bound track"] else []) ++
    (if Term.isConstant d then [] else [s!"{where_}: window length is not a constant term"])
end

-- A declared intention read ahead of the judged observation: an `intent` leaf, or a composed
-- rule that reads one, within the scope of a future operator, in a formula or a term.
mutual
  partial def futureTerm (reads : String → Bool) (fut : Bool) : Term → List String
    | .quantity _ _ ps => ps.flatMap (futureTerm reads fut)
    | .distanceWhile _ φ | .sinceRise φ => futureReads reads fut φ
    | .headingSince _ g ψ => futureTerm reads fut g ++ futureReads reads fut ψ
    | .aggregate _ _ φ t => futureReads reads fut φ ++ futureTerm reads fut t
    | .add a b | .sub a b | .mul a b | .div a b => futureTerm reads fut a ++ futureTerm reads fut b
    | .neg a | .abs a => futureTerm reads fut a
    | .cond φ a b => futureReads reads fut φ ++ futureTerm reads fut a ++ futureTerm reads fut b
    | _ => []
  partial def futureReads (reads : String → Bool) (fut : Bool) : Formula → List String
    | .intent id _ _ => if fut then [s!"declared intention `{id}` is read ahead of the judged observation"] else []
    | .rule id _ | .ruleApplies id _ =>
      if fut && reads id then [s!"`{id}` reads a declared intention and is read ahead of the judged observation"] else []
    | .atom _ _ ps | .derived _ _ ps => ps.flatMap (futureTerm reads fut)
    | .cmp l _ r => futureTerm reads fut l ++ futureTerm reads fut r
    | .always φ | .eventually φ => futureReads reads true φ
    | .until φ ψ => futureReads reads true φ ++ futureReads reads true ψ
    | .within _ d _ φ => futureTerm reads fut d ++ futureReads reads true φ
    | .untilWithin _ d _ φ ψ => futureTerm reads fut d ++ futureReads reads true φ ++ futureReads reads true ψ
    | .not φ | .rises φ => futureReads reads fut φ
    | .and φ ψ | .or φ ψ | .implies φ ψ | .since φ ψ | .definedWhen φ ψ => futureReads reads fut φ ++ futureReads reads fut ψ
    | .holdsFor _ d _ φ => futureTerm reads fut d ++ futureReads reads fut φ
    | .atLast _ d _ ψ φ => futureTerm reads fut d ++ futureReads reads fut ψ ++ futureReads reads fut φ
    | .count e sφ _ _ => futureReads reads fut e ++ futureReads reads fut sφ
    | .existsRegion _ _ φ | .forallRegion _ _ φ | .existsDevice _ _ φ | .forallDevice _ _ φ
    | .existsUser _ φ | .forallUser _ φ => futureReads reads fut φ
    | _ => []
end

-- The distance travelled since the trace began (`kin_path_length`), whose zero is the start of the
-- recording, read where it can decide a search into the past: inside an operand of `since`, of
-- `atLast` or of `count`, inside the formula of `sinceRise`, the onset of `headingSince` or the
-- formula of `rises`, directly or through a composed rule that reads it. Everywhere else it is
-- ordinary arithmetic; path windows and `distanceWhile` measure differences and are never this.
mutual
  partial def pathTerm (reads : String → Bool) (back : Bool) : Term → List String
    | .measure "kin_path_length" _ =>
      if back then ["the distance travelled since the trace began (`kin_path_length`) is read inside a search into the past (`since`, `sinceRise`, `atLast`, `count` or `rises`); the start of a recording is no event of a road user's history"] else []
    | .quantity _ _ ps => ps.flatMap (pathTerm reads back)
    | .distanceWhile _ φ => pathReads reads back φ
    | .sinceRise φ => pathReads reads true φ
    | .headingSince _ g ψ => pathTerm reads back g ++ pathReads reads true ψ
    | .aggregate _ _ φ t => pathReads reads back φ ++ pathTerm reads back t
    | .add a b | .sub a b | .mul a b | .div a b => pathTerm reads back a ++ pathTerm reads back b
    | .neg a | .abs a => pathTerm reads back a
    | .cond φ a b => pathReads reads back φ ++ pathTerm reads back a ++ pathTerm reads back b
    | _ => []
  partial def pathReads (reads : String → Bool) (back : Bool) : Formula → List String
    | .rule id _ | .ruleApplies id _ =>
      if back && reads id then [s!"`{id}` reads the distance travelled since the trace began and is composed inside a search into the past"] else []
    | .atom _ _ ps | .derived _ _ ps => ps.flatMap (pathTerm reads back)
    | .cmp l _ r => pathTerm reads back l ++ pathTerm reads back r
    | .since φ ψ => pathReads reads true φ ++ pathReads reads true ψ
    | .atLast _ d _ ψ φ => pathTerm reads back d ++ pathReads reads true ψ ++ pathReads reads true φ
    | .count e sφ _ _ => pathReads reads true e ++ pathReads reads true sφ
    | .rises φ => pathReads reads true φ
    | .not φ | .always φ | .eventually φ => pathReads reads back φ
    | .and φ ψ | .or φ ψ | .implies φ ψ | .until φ ψ | .definedWhen φ ψ => pathReads reads back φ ++ pathReads reads back ψ
    | .holdsFor _ d _ φ | .within _ d _ φ => pathTerm reads back d ++ pathReads reads back φ
    | .untilWithin _ d _ φ ψ => pathTerm reads back d ++ pathReads reads back φ ++ pathReads reads back ψ
    | .existsRegion _ _ φ | .forallRegion _ _ φ | .existsDevice _ _ φ | .forallDevice _ _ φ
    | .existsUser _ φ | .forallUser _ φ => pathReads reads back φ
    | _ => []
end

/-- Whether a rule, or a rule it composes, reads `kin_path_length` anywhere. -/
def readsPath (rules : List Rule) (r : Rule) : Bool :=
  (closure rules r).any fun x => x.formulas.any fun φ => !(pathReads (fun _ => false) true φ).isEmpty

/-- Every defect a rule has before any trace; empty for a rule the evaluator will never report
    `malformed` or `unboundVariable` on: an empty id; no binder, or one unnamed or named twice;
    an assumption or intention read but not declared, or an intention id ill-formed; an
    operationalization bounded by nothing, or by a name that is no atom, primitive or concept; a
    name no table knows; an atom, measure, primitive or concept given the wrong number of
    arguments; an unbound variable, or one of the wrong sort where a track, region or device is
    read (such a position takes a variable, never a spelling or a number; a literal position
    takes no variable); a spelling no enumeration decodes; a quantifier kind that is not a
    spelling; a parameter of an atom or a call, or a window's length, that is not a constant
    term (a literal, a reading parameter, or arithmetic over them); a heading change's step bound
    that is not a literal or a reading parameter, or a literal one not strictly positive; a
    declared intention read ahead of the judged observation; the distance travelled since the trace began read inside a
    search into the past; a composed rule not in the set, or a map that names a variable not
    bound to a track, misses one of its binders or names one it does not have. `regions` names
    variables the caller binds to regions: the region formals of a concept's instance, which
    alone may then have no binder. -/
def check (rules : List Rule) (r : Rule) (regions : List String := []) : List String :=
  let scope : Scope := r.binderNames.map (fun n => (n, EntityKind.track)) ++ regions.map fun n => (n, EntityKind.region)
  let formed := if regions.isEmpty then r.wellFormed else r.wellFormedBody
  let reads (id : String) : Bool := match rules.find? (·.id == id) with
    | some r' => r'.readsIntention rules
    | none => false
  (if formed then [] else [s!"{r.id}: binders empty, duplicated or unnamed, an assumption, intention or concept undeclared, or an intention id ill-formed"]) ++
  (r.binders.flatMap fun b => checkFormula [(b.name, .track)] s!"{r.id} binder `{b.name}`" b.cls) ++
  checkFormula scope s!"{r.id} applicability" r.applicability ++
  checkFormula scope s!"{r.id} obligation" r.obligation ++
  (r.formulas.flatMap (futureReads reads false) |>.eraseDups.map fun e => s!"{r.id}: {e}") ++
  (r.formulas.flatMap (pathReads (fun id => (rules.find? (·.id == id)).any (readsPath rules)) false)
    |>.eraseDups.map fun e => s!"{r.id}: {e}") ++
  (r.formulas.flatMap Formula.compositions).flatMap (fun (id, map) =>
    match rules.find? (·.id == id) with
    | none => [s!"{r.id}: composes unknown rule `{id}`"]
    | some r' =>
      (map.filter (fun (inner, _) => !r'.binderNames.contains inner) |>.map fun (inner, _) => s!"{r.id}: composition of `{id}` maps `{inner}`, not one of its binders") ++
      (r'.binderNames.filter (fun b => !map.any (·.1 == b)) |>.map fun b => s!"{r.id}: composition of `{id}` leaves its binder `{b}` unmapped"))

/-- The aggregate ids `who` names that the reading does not declare, or whose declaration lists
    an id that is no road-user class. -/
def aggregateDefects (who : String) (ids : List String) (ρ : Reading) : List String :=
  ids.eraseDups.flatMap fun w =>
    match ρ.aggregate w with
    | none => [s!"{who}: aggregate `{w}` is not declared by the reading"]
    | some a => (a.included ++ a.unresolved).filter (fun id => !id.startsWith "ru." || (RoadUserClass.ofString (id.drop 3).toString).isNone)
        |>.map fun id => s!"{who}: aggregate `{w}` lists `{id}`, which is not a road-user class"

/-- Parameters and aggregates that the rule, or a rule it composes, names and the reading lacks,
    each rule read with its calls of the concepts `cs` expanded. -/
def checkReading (rules : List Rule) (r : Rule) (ρ : Reading) (cs : List Concept := []) : List String :=
  (Rule.closure rules r).flatMap fun x =>
    let xx := Concept.expandRule cs x
    (xx.params.filter (!ρ.has ·) |>.map fun p => s!"{x.id}: parameter `{p}` is not in the reading")
    ++ aggregateDefects x.id (xx.formulas.flatMap Formula.aggregateIds) ρ

end Rule

/-- Rule composition over a library, with fuel bounding the nesting depth. The composed rule's
    binders are bound through `map` (inner binder ↦ caller variable); an unmapped binder is an
    unbound variable, an unknown id is `compositionUnknown`. `engaged` selects the composed
    rule's applicability (for an exception or a condition) over its compliance. -/
def composeWith (rules : List Rule) (d : Primitives.Ctx) :
    Nat → String → List (String × String) → Binding → Bool → Array R
  | 0, id, _, _, _ => Array.replicate d.n (R.u (.compositionUnknown id))
  | fuel + 1, id, map, β, engaged =>
    match rules.find? (·.id == id) with
    | none => Array.replicate d.n (R.u (.compositionUnknown id))
    | some r =>
      let β' : Binding := ⟨map.filterMap fun (inner, outer) => (β.lookup outer).map fun v => (inner, v)⟩
      let c : Semantics.SemCtx := { d := d, β := β', compose := composeWith rules d fuel }
      if engaged then r.engagedAll c else r.asRAll c

/-- The evaluation context for a rule set over an indexed trace: composition resolves against
    `rules`, nested at most `rules.length` deep. -/
def Rule.context (rules : List Rule) (d : Primitives.Ctx) (β : Binding) : Semantics.SemCtx :=
  { d := d, β := β, compose := composeWith rules d rules.length }

namespace Concept
open Semantics

-- Every concept call against the callee's signature: a track formal takes a variable bound to a
-- track, a region formal one bound to a region, a literal formal one of its admissible values, a
-- nat formal a number. Run on formulas whose own literal and nat formals already hold values.
mutual
  partial def termCallDefects (cs : List Concept) (scope : Rule.Scope) (where_ : String) : Term → List String
    | .quantity n args ps => callArgs cs scope where_ n args ++ ps.flatMap (termCallDefects cs scope where_)
    | .measure _ _ | .lit _ _ | .param _ => []
    | .distanceWhile _ φ | .sinceRise φ => callDefects cs scope where_ φ
    | .headingSince _ g ψ => termCallDefects cs scope where_ g ++ callDefects cs scope where_ ψ
    | .aggregate _ v φ t => callDefects cs ((v, .track) :: scope) where_ φ ++ termCallDefects cs ((v, .track) :: scope) where_ t
    | .add a b | .sub a b | .mul a b | .div a b => termCallDefects cs scope where_ a ++ termCallDefects cs scope where_ b
    | .neg a | .abs a => termCallDefects cs scope where_ a
    | .cond φ a b => callDefects cs scope where_ φ ++ termCallDefects cs scope where_ a ++ termCallDefects cs scope where_ b
  partial def callDefects (cs : List Concept) (scope : Rule.Scope) (where_ : String) : Formula → List String
    | .derived n args ps => callArgs cs scope where_ n args ++ ps.flatMap (termCallDefects cs scope where_)
    | .atom _ _ ps => ps.flatMap (termCallDefects cs scope where_)
    | .cmp l _ r => termCallDefects cs scope where_ l ++ termCallDefects cs scope where_ r
    | .not φ | .always φ | .eventually φ | .rises φ => callDefects cs scope where_ φ
    | .and φ ψ | .or φ ψ | .implies φ ψ | .until φ ψ | .since φ ψ | .definedWhen φ ψ | .count φ ψ _ _ =>
      callDefects cs scope where_ φ ++ callDefects cs scope where_ ψ
    | .holdsFor _ d _ φ | .within _ d _ φ => termCallDefects cs scope where_ d ++ callDefects cs scope where_ φ
    | .untilWithin _ d _ φ ψ | .atLast _ d _ φ ψ =>
      termCallDefects cs scope where_ d ++ callDefects cs scope where_ φ ++ callDefects cs scope where_ ψ
    | .existsUser v φ | .forallUser v φ => callDefects cs ((v, .track) :: scope) where_ φ
    | .existsRegion _ v φ | .forallRegion _ v φ => callDefects cs ((v, .region) :: scope) where_ φ
    | .existsDevice _ v φ | .forallDevice _ v φ => callDefects cs ((v, .device) :: scope) where_ φ
    | _ => []
  partial def callArgs (cs : List Concept) (scope : Rule.Scope) (where_ name : String) (args : List Arg) : List String :=
    match cs.find? (·.leanName == name) with
    | none => []
    | some c =>
      if args.length != c.args.length then []        -- an arity the expansion leaves for `Rule.check` to report
      else (c.args.zip args).filterMap fun ((n, so), a) =>
        let bad := some s!"{where_}: `{c.id}` formal `{n}` ({repr so}) is given {repr a}"
        match so, a with
        | .track, .var v => if scope.binds v .track then none else bad
        | .region, .var v => if scope.binds v .region then none else bad
        | .literal vs, .lit l => if vs.contains l then none else bad
        | .nat, .nat _ => none
        | _, _ => bad
end

/-- `callDefects` on a rule before expansion: each binder's class with that binder, the
    applicability and the obligation with every binder, all as tracks. -/
def ruleCallDefects (cs : List Concept) (r : Rule) : List String :=
  let scope : Rule.Scope := r.binderNames.map fun n => (n, EntityKind.track)
  (r.binders.flatMap fun b => callDefects cs [(b.name, .track)] s!"{r.id} binder `{b.name}`" b.cls) ++
  callDefects cs scope s!"{r.id} applicability" r.applicability ++
  callDefects cs scope s!"{r.id} obligation" r.obligation


/-- Every defect a concept has before any trace: an empty id; a formal or a parameter named
    twice; a parameter named as a reading's, or a body parameter that is no formal parameter; a
    literal formal that admits no value; a composed rule or a declared intention in the body (a
    concept reads neither); a referenced concept unknown, or a reference cycle; and, on every
    admissible instantiation of its literal formals with its calls expanded, every defect
    `Rule.check` finds in a formula and a call whose arguments do not fit the callee's formals. -/
def check (cs : List Concept) (c : Concept) : List String :=
  let names := c.args.map (·.1)
  let pnames := c.paramNames
  let body := c.bodyFormula
  let structural :=
    (if c.id.isEmpty then ["concept: empty id"] else []) ++
    (if names.eraseDups.length != names.length then [s!"{c.id}: duplicate formal argument"] else []) ++
    (if pnames.eraseDups.length != pnames.length then [s!"{c.id}: duplicate formal parameter"] else []) ++
    (pnames.filter (·.contains '.') |>.map fun p => s!"{c.id}: parameter `{p}` names a reading parameter; a body references its formals only") ++
    (c.args.filterMap fun (n, s) => match s with
      | .literal [] => some s!"{c.id}: literal formal `{n}` admits no value"
      | _ => none) ++
    ((Formula.params body).eraseDups.filter (!pnames.contains ·) |>.map fun p => s!"{c.id}: `{p}` is not a formal parameter") ++
    ((Formula.composed body).map fun id => s!"{c.id}: a concept composes no rule (`{id}`)") ++
    ((Formula.intentions body).eraseDups.map fun id => s!"{c.id}: a concept reads no declared intention (`{id}`)") ++
    (c.refs.filter (fun n => !cs.any (·.leanName == n))
      |>.map fun n => s!"{c.id}: references unknown concept `{n}`") ++
    (if (onCycle cs).contains c.id then [s!"{c.id}: on a reference cycle"] else [])
  let scope : Rule.Scope := c.args.filterMap fun (n, s) => match s with
    | .track => some (n, EntityKind.track)
    | .region => some (n, EntityKind.region)
    | _ => none
  let ps : List Term := c.params.map fun p => Term.param p.name
  let byInstance := (samples c).flatMap fun args =>
    match instantiate c args ps "check" with
    | none => [s!"{c.id}: arity"]
    | some b =>
      let φ := match b with | .formula φ => φ | .quantity t => Formula.cmp t .eq t
      let φx := expand cs φ
      callDefects cs scope c.id φ ++ Rule.checkFormula scope c.id φx ++
        (Rule.pathReads (fun _ => false) false φx).map fun e => s!"{c.id}: {e}"
  structural ++ byInstance.eraseDups

/-- The aggregates a concept's body names, its calls expanded, that the reading does not declare
    or declares with an id that is no road-user class. -/
def checkReading (cs : List Concept) (c : Concept) (ρ : Reading) : List String :=
  Rule.aggregateDefects c.id (aggregateIds cs c) ρ

end Concept

end TrafficSpec

340	/-- Whether a name is known to either table (the doctor holds this against `atomIds`). -/
341	def knowsAtom (n : String) : Bool :=
342	  let s : Scene := { t := 0 }
343	  let isUnknown : Except UnknownReason R → Bool
344	    | .error e => e == unknownAtom n
345	    | _ => false
346	  let isUnknownQ : QR → Bool
347	    | .error e => e == unknownAtom n
348	    | _ => false
349	  !(isUnknown (evalAtomE s n [] []) && isUnknownQ (evalMeasure s n []))

351	/-- The sort each entity argument of an atom must have (`none` marks a literal position): by
352	    family, with the mixed atoms listed. `none` for a name the tables do not know. -/
353	def atomArgSorts (name : String) : Option (List (Option EntityKind)) :=
354	  let t := some EntityKind.track; let r := some EntityKind.region; let d := some EntityKind.device
355	  match name with
356	  | "rel_occupies" => some [t, r]
357	  | "ru_aggregate" => some [t, none]
358	  | "dev_governs" => some [d, r]
359	  | "st_region_geometry_distance" | "st_sight_along_way" => some [t, r]
360	  | "st_lane_adjacency" => some [r, none, r]
361	  | "st_lane_adjacency_left" | "st_lane_adjacency_right" | "st_lane_connectivity" | "st_lane_enters" | "st_on_way"
362	  | "st_entrance_of" => some [r, r]
363	  | "st_lane_marking" => some [r, none, none, none]
364	  | "rel_oncoming" | "rel_same_direction" | "rel_ahead_behind_in_lane" | "rel_ahead_in_lane"
365	  | "rel_behind_in_lane" | "rel_contact" | "rel_visible" | "rel_centre_distance" | "rel_longitudinal_overlap" => some [t, t]
366	  | "rel_surface_gap" | "rel_bearing" => some [t, t, none]
367	  | n =>
368	    if !knowsAtom n then none
369	    else if n.startsWith "env_" || n == "kin_time" then some []
370	    else if n.startsWith "ru_" || n.startsWith "kin_" || n.startsWith "sig_" then some [t, none, none]
371	    else if n.startsWith "st_" then some [r, none, none]
372	    else if n.startsWith "dev_" then some [d, none, none]
373	    else none

381	def constU (n : Nat) (w : UnknownReason) : Array R := const n (R.u w)
382	def constE (n : Nat) (w : UnknownReason) : Array QR := Array.replicate n (.error w)
383	def liftA (n : Nat) (e : Except UnknownReason (Array R)) : Array R :=
384	  match e with | .ok a => a | .error w => constU n w
385	def liftQ (n : Nat) (e : Except UnknownReason (Array QR)) : Array QR :=

390	/-- A term that names no instant: a literal, a parameter or arithmetic over those. Only such a
391	    term may parametrize an atom or a derived concept. -/
392	partial def Term.isConstant : Term → Bool
393	  | .lit _ _ | .param _ => true
394	  | .add a b | .sub a b | .mul a b | .div a b => Term.isConstant a && Term.isConstant b
395	  | .neg a | .abs a => Term.isConstant a
396	  | _ => false

401	  arr[0]?.getD (.error .outOfRange)

446	/-- φ where the precondition holds; undefined where it is false; the precondition's reasons where
447	    it is unknown. -/
448	def definedWhenR (pre x : R) : R :=
449	  match pre.v with
450	  | .t => x
451	  | .f => R.u (.undefined "defined_when")
452	  | .u => ⟨.u, pre.why⟩

454	/-- A selection at one instant: the branch the guard picks; where the guard is unknown, the
455	    branches' common value, else unknown with the guard's reasons. -/
456	def condAt (g : R) (a b : QR) : QR :=
457	  match g.v with
458	  | .t => a
459	  | .f => b
460	  | .u => match a, b with
461	    | .ok x, .ok y => if Q.eq x y then .ok x else .error (g.why.head?.getD (.malformed "cond"))
462	    | _, _ => .error (g.why.head?.getD (.malformed "cond"))

464	/-- An aggregate over the members present at one instant: unknown when a member's membership is
465	    unknown or a member's value is; `count` on an empty set is zero, the others are undefined. -/
466	def aggregateAt (op : AggOp) (xs : List (R × QR)) : QR :=
467	  match xs.find? (fun (f, _) => f.v == .u) with
468	  | some (f, _) => .error (f.why.head?.getD (.malformed "aggregate"))
469	  | none =>
470	    let vals := xs.filterMap fun (f, q) => if f.v == .t then some q else none
471	    match op with
472	    | .count => .ok (Q.ofInt (Int.ofNat vals.length))
473	    | _ => do
474	      let qs ← vals.mapM fun q => q
475	      if qs.isEmpty then .error (.undefined "aggregate")
476	      else
477	        let sorted := qs.toArray.qsort (fun a b => Q.lt a b)
478	        match op with
479	        | .min => .ok sorted[0]!
480	        | .max => .ok sorted[sorted.size - 1]!
481	        | _ => .ok sorted[sorted.size / 2]!
482	
483	/-- Membership of a road user in a legal aggregate at one scene: true when it carries an included
484	    class; unknown, with the observation's reason, when an included or unresolved class it might
485	    carry is unobserved; unknown as `aggregateUnresolved` when it carries a class the definition
486	    leaves unresolved; false otherwise. -/
487	def aggregateMembership (s : Scene) (t : TrackId) (a : LegalAggregate) : R :=
488	  let classes := fun (ids : List String) => ids.filterMap fun i => RoadUserClass.ofString (i.drop 3).toString
489	  match ru_aggregate s t (classes a.included) with
490	  | some true => R.t
491	  | none => R.u (.absentAtom "ru_aggregate")
492	  | some false =>
493	    match ru_aggregate s t (classes a.unresolved) with
494	    | some true => R.u (.aggregateUnresolved a.id)
495	    | some false => R.f
496	    | none => R.u (.absentAtom "ru_aggregate")

498	/-- Kleene aggregate at each instant over the evaluated members present in that scene. -/
499	def perScene (c : SemCtx) (evaluated : List (Nat × Array R))
500	    (presentIn : Scene → Nat → Bool) (agg : List R → R) : Array R :=
501	  (Array.range c.n).map fun i =>
502	    let s := c.scenes[i]!
503	    agg (evaluated.filterMap fun (m, arr) => if presentIn s m then some arr[i]! else none)
504	
505	mutual
506	  def evalTAll (c : SemCtx) : Term → Array QR
507	    | .lit v _ => Array.replicate c.n (.ok v)
508	    | .param p => Array.replicate c.n (match c.d.ρ.param p with | some v => .ok v | none => .error (.parameterMissing p))
509	    | .measure a args =>
510	      match resolveAll c.β args with
511	      | .error w => constE c.n w
512	      | .ok ds => c.scenes.map fun s => evalMeasure s a ds
513	    | .quantity concept args ps =>
514	      liftQ c.n do
515	        let vs ← constParams c ps
516	        Primitives.evalQ concept c.d (← resolveAll c.β args) vs
517	    | .distanceWhile subj φ =>
518	      match c.β.track subj with
519	      | none => constE c.n (.unboundVariable subj)
520	      | some x => Primitives.distanceWhile c.d x (evalAll c φ)
521	    | .sinceRise φ => sinceRiseAll c.d.times (evalAll c φ)
522	    | .headingSince subj g ψ =>
523	      match c.β.track subj with
524	      | none => constE c.n (.unboundVariable subj)
525	      | some x => liftQ c.n do
526	          let gv ← stepOf g (evalTAll c g)
527	          pure (Primitives.headingSince c.d x gv (evalAll c ψ))
528	    | .aggregate op v φ t =>
529	      let members := (usersOf c).map fun u =>
530	        let c' := c.bindVar v (.track u)
531	        (u, evalAll c' φ, evalTAll c' t)
532	      (Array.range c.n).map fun i =>
533	        let s := c.scenes[i]!
534	        aggregateAt op (members.filterMap fun (u, fa, ta) => if s.tracks.contains u then some (fa[i]!, ta[i]!) else none)
535	    | .add a b' => qzip Q.add (evalTAll c a) (evalTAll c b')
536	    | .sub a b' => qzip Q.sub (evalTAll c a) (evalTAll c b')
537	    | .mul a b' => qzip Q.mul (evalTAll c a) (evalTAll c b')
538	    | .div a b' => Array.zipWith (fun x y => do
539	        let d ← y
540	        if Q.isZero d then .error (.divisionByZero "div") else pure (Q.div (← x) d)) (evalTAll c a) (evalTAll c b')
541	    | .neg a => (evalTAll c a).map (·.map Q.neg)
542	    | .abs a => (evalTAll c a).map (·.map Q.abs)
543	    | .cond φ a b' =>
544	      let g := evalAll c φ; let x := evalTAll c a; let y := evalTAll c b'
545	      (Array.range c.n).map fun i => condAt (g[i]?.getD (R.u .outOfRange)) (x[i]?.getD (.error .outOfRange)) (y[i]?.getD (.error .outOfRange))
546	  termination_by t => sizeOf t
547	
548	  /-- Parameters of an atom or derived concept: constant terms, evaluated once. -/
549	  def constParams (c : SemCtx) : List Term → Except UnknownReason (List Q)
550	    | [] => .ok []
551	    | t :: rest => do
552	      let v ← constOf t (evalTAll c t)
553	      pure (v :: (← constParams c rest))
554	  termination_by ts => sizeOf ts
555	
556	  def evalAll (c : SemCtx) : Formula → Array R
557	    | .tt => const c.n R.t
558	    | .ff => const c.n R.f
559	    | .atom name args ps =>
560	      liftA c.n do
561	        let vs ← constParams c ps
562	        let ds ← resolveAll c.β args
563	        if name == "ru_aggregate" then
564	          pure (match ds with
565	            | [.v t, .s id] =>
566	              match c.d.aggregateOverrides.find? (fun (x, a, _) => x == t && a == id) with
567	              | some (_, _, v) => const c.n (R.ofBool v)
568	              | none =>
569	                match c.d.ρ.aggregate id with
570	                | none => const c.n (R.u (.parameterMissing s!"aggregate:{id}"))
571	                | some a => c.scenes.map fun s => aggregateMembership s t a
572	            | _ => const c.n (R.u (.malformed "aggregate arguments")))
573	        else pure (c.scenes.map fun s => match evalAtomE s name ds vs with | .ok r => r | .error w => R.u w)
574	    | .cmp l op r => Array.zipWith (fun x y => match x, y with
575	        | .ok a, .ok b => R.ofBool (op.apply a b)
576	        | .error w, _ | _, .error w => R.u w) (evalTAll c l) (evalTAll c r)
577	    | .asm id => c.scenes.map fun s => R.ofOption (s.assumption id) (.assumptionMissing id)
578	    | .intent id who target =>
579	      match who, target with
580	      | .var a, .var b =>
581	        match c.β.lookup a, c.β.lookup b with
582	        | some (.track x), some (.region r) => c.scenes.map fun s => R.ofOption (s.intention id x r) (.intentionMissing id)
583	        | none, _ => constU c.n (.unboundVariable a)
584	        | _, none => constU c.n (.unboundVariable b)
585	        | _, _ => constU c.n (.malformed "intent: a track and a region expected")
586	      | _, _ => constU c.n (.malformed "intent: a track and a region expected")
587	    | .same a b =>
588	      match resolve c.β a, resolve c.β b with
589	      | .ok (.v i), .ok (.v j) => const c.n (R.ofBool (i == j))
590	      | .error w, _ | _, .error w => constU c.n w
591	      | _, _ => constU c.n (.malformed "same: entities expected")
592	    | .not φ => mapNot (evalAll c φ)
593	    -- a connective whose left operand settles it at every instant does not evaluate its right one
594	    | .and φ ψ =>
595	      let a := evalAll c φ
596	      if a.all (·.v == .f) then a.map (fun _ => R.f) else zipAnd a (evalAll c ψ)
597	    | .or φ ψ =>
598	      let a := evalAll c φ
599	      if a.all (·.v == .t) then a.map (fun _ => R.t) else zipOr a (evalAll c ψ)
600	    | .implies φ ψ =>
601	      let a := evalAll c φ
602	      if a.all (·.v == .f) then a.map (fun _ => R.t) else zipImplies a (evalAll c ψ)
603	    | .always φ => alwaysAll (evalAll c φ)
604	    | .eventually φ => eventuallyAll (evalAll c φ)
605	    | .until φ ψ => untilAll (evalAll c φ) (evalAll c ψ)
606	    | .since φ ψ => sinceAll (evalAll c φ) (evalAll c ψ)
607	    | .holdsFor m d subj φ =>
608	      liftA c.n do
609	        let x ← subjectFor c.β m subj
610	        let dv ← constOf d (evalTAll c d)
611	        pure (holdsForAll (Primitives.positions c.d m x) dv "holdsFor" (Primitives.missingPos m) (evalAll c φ))
612	    | .within m d subj φ =>
613	      liftA c.n do
614	        let x ← subjectFor c.β m subj
615	        let dv ← constOf d (evalTAll c d)
616	        pure (withinAll (Primitives.positions c.d m x) dv "within" (Primitives.missingPos m) (evalAll c φ))
617	    | .untilWithin m d subj φ ψ =>
618	      liftA c.n do
619	        let x ← subjectFor c.β m subj
620	        let dv ← constOf d (evalTAll c d)
621	        pure (untilWithinAll (Primitives.positions c.d m x) dv "untilWithin" (Primitives.missingPos m) (evalAll c φ) (evalAll c ψ))
622	    | .atLast m d subj ψ φ =>
623	      liftA c.n do
624	        let x ← subjectFor c.β m subj
625	        let dv ← constOf d (evalTAll c d)
626	        pure (atLastAll (Primitives.positions c.d m x) dv "atLast" (Primitives.missingPos m) (evalAll c ψ) (evalAll c φ))
627	    | .count edge sinceφ op k =>
628	      (countEdgesAll "count" (evalAll c edge) (evalAll c sinceφ)).map fun e => match e with
629	        | .error w => R.u w
630	        | .ok m => R.ofBool (op.apply (Q.ofInt (Int.ofNat m)) (Q.ofInt (Int.ofNat k)))
631	    | .rises φ => risesAll (evalAll c φ)
632	    | .definedWhen pre φ => Array.zipWith definedWhenR (evalAll c pre) (evalAll c φ)
633	    | .derived concept args ps =>
634	      liftA c.n do
635	        let vs ← constParams c ps
636	        Primitives.evalB concept c.d (← resolveAll c.β args) vs
637	    | .rule id map =>
638	      let arr := c.compose id map c.β false
639	      if arr.size = c.n then arr else constU c.n (.compositionUnknown id)
640	    | .ruleApplies id map =>
641	      let arr := c.compose id map c.β true
642	      if arr.size = c.n then arr else constU c.n (.compositionUnknown id)
643	    | .existsUser v φ =>
644	      perScene c ((usersOf c).map fun t => (t, evalAll (c.bindVar v (.track t)) φ))
645	        (fun s t => s.tracks.contains t) R.any
646	    | .forallUser v φ =>
647	      perScene c ((usersOf c).map fun t => (t, evalAll (c.bindVar v (.track t)) φ))
648	        (fun s t => s.tracks.contains t) R.all
649	    | .existsRegion k v φ =>
650	      match regionKindOf k with
651	      | .error w => constU c.n w
652	      | .ok kd => perScene c ((regionsOf c kd).map fun r =>
653	            (r, Array.zipWith R.and (regionIsKind c r kd) (evalAll (c.bindVar v (.region r)) φ)))
654	          (fun s r => (s.structure? r).isSome) R.any
655	    | .forallRegion k v φ =>
656	      match regionKindOf k with
657	      | .error w => constU c.n w
658	      | .ok kd => perScene c ((regionsOf c kd).map fun r =>
659	            (r, Array.zipWith R.implies (regionIsKind c r kd) (evalAll (c.bindVar v (.region r)) φ)))
660	          (fun s r => (s.structure? r).isSome) R.all
661	    | .existsDevice k v φ =>
662	      match deviceKindOf k with
663	      | .error w => constU c.n w
664	      | .ok kd => perScene c ((devicesOf c kd).map fun d =>
665	            (d, Array.zipWith R.and (deviceIsKind c d kd) (evalAll (c.bindVar v (.device d)) φ)))
666	          (fun s d => (s.device d).isSome) R.any
667	    | .forallDevice k v φ =>
668	      match deviceKindOf k with
669	      | .error w => constU c.n w
670	      | .ok kd => perScene c ((devicesOf c kd).map fun d =>
671	            (d, Array.zipWith R.implies (deviceIsKind c d kd) (evalAll (c.bindVar v (.device d)) φ)))
672	          (fun s d => (s.device d).isSome) R.all
673	  termination_by φ => sizeOf φ
674	end

677	def eval (c : SemCtx) (i : Nat) (φ : Formula) : R := (evalAll c φ)[i]?.getD (R.u .outOfRange)
678	def evalTri (c : SemCtx) (i : Nat) (φ : Formula) : Tri := (eval c i φ).v

683	section Lengths
